function puterMessages(history,jsonMode,sysPrompt){
  const msgs=[{role:"system",content:(sysPrompt||SYS_PROMPT())+(jsonMode?" Respond ONLY with valid JSON.":"")}];
  const hs=history||[];
  for(let hi=0;hi<hs.length;hi++){
    const h=hs[hi];
    const txt=(h.parts||[]).map(p=>p.text||"").join(" ");
    const recent=hi>=hs.length-4;
    const imgs=recent?(h.parts||[]).filter(p=>p.inline_data&&p.inline_data.data):[];
    if(!txt.trim()&&!imgs.length)continue;
    if(imgs.length){
      const content=[{type:"text",text:txt.trim()||"Solve the question in this image step by step and give the final answer clearly."}];
      imgs.forEach(p=>content.push({type:"image_url",image_url:{url:"data:"+(p.inline_data.mime_type||"image/jpeg")+";base64,"+p.inline_data.data}}));
      msgs.push({role:h.role==="model"?"assistant":"user",content:content});
    }else{
      msgs.push({role:h.role==="model"?"assistant":"user",content:txt});
    }
  }
  return msgs;
}
